user.title: Connect Tuya Cloud project
user.description: Only enter Access ID, Access Secret and region. No app login is needed at runtime; linking the app account is a one-time step in the Tuya console.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Tuya access
reauth_confirm.description: Authentication with the Tuya project failed. Please re-enter the Access ID, Access Secret and region.

error.invalid_auth: Access ID, Access Secret or signature is invalid. Also check the host's system time.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Tuya Cloud. Check the internet connection and the selected region.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to the Tuya project.

abort.already_configured: This Tuya project is already configured.

init.title: Tuya Project Cloud options
init.description: Saving reloads the integration. Disabled platforms leave their entities unavailable; existing entity IDs are not deleted.

data.enable_shadow: Read IoT Core thing shadow data (charger values, refreshed every minute)

command_not_authorized.message: Tuya rejected the control command (error 1106). Check the cloud project permissions and whether the device is authorized.

api_not_authorized.title: Tuya API not authorized
api_not_authorized.description: The project is not allowed to call the Device API (/v1.0/devices). Enable it in the Tuya console under 'Service API → Add Authorization'.

iot_core_not_authorized.title: IoT Core not authorized
iot_core_not_authorized.description: The thing shadow API is not enabled for this project. Enable IoT Core in the Tuya console and authorize the cloud project; charger sensors remain unavailable until access is granted.

command_not_authorized.title: Device command not allowed
command_not_authorized.description: Tuya rejected a control command (error 1106). Check the cloud project permissions and whether the device is authorized.

region_mismatch.title: No devices found
region_mismatch.description: No devices were found. Check the selected region and whether an app account is linked to the cloud project in the Tuya console.
